baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted object al-ard, temporal ba'da dhalika, and the pronominal object of dahaha form a later act performed upon the earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The earth branch supplies the lower member opposite the sky, while the after-branch orders this earth-directed act behind a prior, still unspecified phase.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the lower expanse opposite the sky and makes the object of dahaha a spatial counterpart rather than an unqualified object.
Supplies succession after what came before and orders the earth-act as a subsequent phase.

changed_reading.before: A bare statement that the earth was spread afterward.
changed_reading.after: The lower counterpart to the sky is taken up in a distinct later phase and given its expanse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-ard is the direct object of dahaha, and its branch inventory includes soft, established, abundantly growing earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fertile-earth branch lets the spreading act concern usable, growth-bearing terrain rather than geometry alone, although the focus verb itself has no supplied branch inventory.

activation_trace.role: Supplies soft, well-grown, established earth and gives the object of spreading a latent productive capacity.

changed_reading.before: Dahaha changes only the shape or extent of inert ground.
changed_reading.after: Dahaha may configure an expanse as growth-bearing terrain, with productivity latent in the object being acted upon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier follow-after pair makes ba'da dhalika function not only as a date-like marker but as a hinge between linked operations: one phase comes in the wake of another.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the focus phrase in the relation of a later act to a prior one.
Supplies continuous succession and sharpens the focus construction as a link in an ordered sequence.
Supplies an event coming after another and reinforces the wake-like force of ba'd.

structural_cues: 79:6-7 presents two events in explicit succession, and 79:30 likewise enters after the multi-act sky sequence of 79:27-29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit follow-after event pair and the focus ba'd construction; I infer that this pattern sensitizes ba'd as a phase-link, while the live alternative is an ordinary temporal adverb with no discourse-level echo.

changed_reading.before: After that is chiefly a claim about calendar-like chronology.
changed_reading.after: After that also organizes the discourse into linked operational phases, without by itself settling the absolute chronology of every named phenomenon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The raised, completed overhead structure and the lower earth form a coupled vertical architecture. Dahaha supplies the lower expanse after the upper member has been built, raised, and set in order.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the lower member opposite the sky and anchors dahaha as work on the architecture's lower plane.
Supplies the transition from the preceding upper-structure operations to the earth-directed operation.
Supplies what rises overhead and shades, providing the upper counterpart to the focus earth.
Supplies construction by joining parts and turns the upper counterpart into an assembled structure.
Supplies upward elevation and establishes the vertical direction opposed by the lower earth.
Supplies a roof-like structural height that can be paired with the earth as a lower plane.
Supplies straightness and completion, making the sky sequence a finished upper-ordering phase before the earth-act.

structural_cues: 79:27-30 keeps feminine object pronouns attached first to the sky and then to the fronted earth, creating a coordinated upper-to-lower sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overhead structure, elevation, completion, and the focus branch's lower counterpart; I infer that dahaha completes the lower side of one spatial system, while the live alternative is a list of independent creative acts rather than a coupled architecture.

changed_reading.before: The earth is spread as an isolated object after an unrelated prior event.
changed_reading.after: The earth is configured as the lower expanse of a paired upper/lower order, with ba'da dhalika pivoting from raised canopy to lower terrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated emergence language around the focus act, followed by water, pasture, and useful provision from the earth, recasts dahaha as productive terrain-making that enables contained goods to become available.

activation_trace.role: Supplies soft, established, well-grown earth and anchors the productivity model in the focus object.
Supplies bringing something out of concealment before the focus, opening an emergence pattern.
Repeats bringing-out immediately after dahaha and directs that emergence from the earth.
Supplies water as the first concrete good issuing from the configured earth.
Supplies grazing growth and makes the earth's expansion ecologically productive.
Supplies usable provision for needs and gives the earth sequence an explicit beneficiary-facing function.

structural_cues: 79:29 and 79:31 repeat akhraja on opposite sides of 79:30, while the min-ha construction in 79:31 points the water and pasture back to the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated emergence, earth-origin, water, pasture, and benefit; I infer that configuring the earth enables their availability, while the live alternative is that these are coordinated but causally independent acts.

changed_reading.before: Dahaha is a purely geometric spreading of ground.
changed_reading.after: Dahaha is a productive opening and preparation of terrain from which water and pasture become available as provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The extended earth is immediately paired with hard elevations made firm. Its spread is therefore compatible with differentiated, anchored terrain rather than requiring a featureless flat plane.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the lower earth whose expanse is acted upon by dahaha.
Supplies solid elevated masses that differentiate the earth's spread.
Supplies firmness and fixedness, assigning the elevations a stabilizing role within the terrain.

structural_cues: 79:30-32 keeps the same earth-linked feminine object suffix across spreading, bringing out resources, and fixing mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread earth followed by solid elevations made firm; I infer that both belong to one differentiated terrain system, while the live alternative is that mountain-fixing is simply a separate subsequent act.

changed_reading.before: Spreading the earth means reducing it to a uniformly flat surface.
changed_reading.after: Spreading establishes an extensive lower terrain that can include firmly fixed elevations and internal differentiation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the tremor branch is distant from the ordinary earth noun in the focus; it remains traceable through an exact focus-root branch and the surah's severe-agitation cue, but downstream prose should present it only as a lexical shadow, not as a replacement gloss for al-ard.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory for al-ard includes a rare tremor or bodily-shaking branch, while dahaha acts on that same surface noun.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the rare tremor sense within the focus root and lets ordered earth carry a distant instability echo.
Supplies severe agitation and activates the otherwise remote tremor branch of the focus earth root.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents a simply stable ground being spread.
changed_reading.after: The ordered expanse carries a faint counter-image of tremor: the surface configured here can later be heard against the surah's violent destabilization.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it moves from physical terrain to moral attachment; it remains anchored in the focus branch of clinging heavily to earth and is activated by the lower-life and desire cues, but it should be qualified as a secondary resonance rather than a claim that dahaha itself denotes moral temptation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The al-ard inventory includes clinging to earth and becoming heavy toward it, giving the physically spread object a possible attachment resonance.

activation_trace.role: Supplies clinging and heaviness toward earth, anchoring the moralized resonance in the focus noun.
Supplies deliberate preference and turns attachment to the lower domain into a choice rather than mere location.
Supplies the lower or worldly domain and links the physical lower earth to a later evaluative contrast.
Supplies the soul's inclination and gives the earth-clinging branch an affective direction.

changed_reading.before: The focus earth is only a physical surface made extensive.
changed_reading.after: The spread lower domain also casts a contained lexical shadow as the expanse toward which preference and desire may incline and cling.

strongest_changes: Ba'da dhalika became a phase-link within an ordered sequence, not merely a free-standing chronological datum.
Dahaha became the lower-plane operation in a paired architecture of raised sky and extended earth.
The earth act shifted from bare geometry toward productive preparation and disclosure of water, pasture, and usable provision.
The mountain sequence constrained spreading away from a featureless-flatness model toward differentiated, anchored terrain.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated coexisting temporal, architectural, ecological, and stabilizing mechanisms without forcing them into one final chronology; remote focus-root branches also preserved two explicitly contained lexical outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supplies no branch inventory for the focus verb d-h-w, so the precise force of dahaha cannot be branch-audited here.
Adjacency and shared pronouns support integration but do not prove that spreading causes the later emergence or anchoring acts.
The phase-link reading of ba'da dhalika does not eliminate its straightforward temporal-succession reading or settle an absolute cosmological timeline.
The tremor and moral-attachment outliers depend on distant branches and should remain secondary resonances.
